source.market_name: Will 12 or more Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

market_name: Will 12 or more Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the probability spike is corroborated by moves in SOFR/fed funds futures and 2y yields; if futures are flat, treat the Polymarket move as noise.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT and the 2s10s curve direction; a genuine easing-crisis signal should show bull-steepening or front-end rally.
time_plan.2h: Look for any news catalyst (bank stress, geopolitical shock, labor-market shock) that would justify emergency-cut pricing; absence weakens the thesis.
time_plan.6h: Re-evaluate whether equity and credit markets confirm risk-off; divergence means the signal is isolated.
time_plan.12h: Assess net TLT move vs baseline; log whether the prediction-market anomaly preceded any public macro release.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 12+ Fed cuts in 2026 (300bps of easing, including emergency inter-meeting cuts) would signal the market pricing a recession or financial-crisis scenario forcing aggressive easing. That collapses front-end and long-end yields, sending long-duration Treasury prices higher. TLT is the cleanest liquid proxy for a dovish repricing. However, a 700bps move in 12h would only occur in an acute crisis; the typical response is far smaller, so this is below the tradable threshold under normal conditions.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm DXY is softening and real yields (TIPS) falling alongside the probability move; gold should track lower real rates.
time_plan.1h: Check whether gold strength is broad (silver, miners) or idiosyncratic.
time_plan.2h: Scan for a crisis catalyst consistent with emergency-cut expectations.
time_plan.6h: Reassess dollar and real-rate trend; fading moves undercut the thesis.
time_plan.12h: Log net GLD return vs baseline and whether it co-moved with the Treasury signal.

predictions.reasoning: Pricing of 12+ cuts implies deeply negative real-rate expectations and a weaker dollar, both bullish for gold as a non-yielding safe haven. If the scenario reflects crisis-driven emergency easing, gold also benefits from flight-to-safety demand. The link is directionally sound but noisier than Treasuries, and the magnitude rarely reaches the 700bps tradable bar in a 12h window absent an extreme shock.

evidence_used: Market question implies an extreme easing scenario (12+ cuts = 300bps, including inter-meeting emergency cuts) in 2026
Such pricing historically correlates with recession/crisis expectations
Standard macro transmission: aggressive-easing expectations lower yields, weaken USD, support gold and bonds
uncertainty_notes: A single Polymarket probability move is a noisy, low-liquidity sensor and may not reflect new information
The 700bps tradable threshold is very high for a 12h ETF window and unlikely to be met outside an acute crisis
Direction for equities is genuinely ambiguous — deep cuts can be read as stimulus (bullish) or crisis (bearish)
The market resolves over all of 2026, so near-term asset impact of a probability shift is diluted

llm_justification.summary: The market asks whether the Fed will cut 12+ times (300bps) in 2026 — an extreme outcome that would only become plausible under a recession or financial-crisis scenario forcing emergency easing. A sharp rise in its implied probability would therefore signal a dovish/risk-off macro repricing: long Treasuries and gold rally on collapsing real-rate and safe-haven dynamics. Both mappings are directionally reasonable but modest in typical magnitude and well below the 700bps tradable bar absent an acute shock, so confidence is moderate.
key_assumptions: A probability spike reflects genuine shift in macro expectations rather than thin-market noise
12+ cuts is interpreted by markets as a crisis/recession signal, not benign stimulus
Treasury and gold proxies respond faster than the slow-resolving 2026 question suggests
failure_modes: The Polymarket move is illiquid noise with no public-market follow-through
The easing scenario is read as bullish stimulus, lifting equities and leaving bonds mixed
Information is already public (e.g., a macro print) and priced into TLT/GLD before the signal
12h magnitude falls far short of 700bps, making neither prediction tradable
Dollar and real-rate moves offset gold, breaking the proxy linkage
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
